name: MiseOS GHCR Runner Publish Plan
description: The GHCR-first publication workflow that publishes the MiseOS runner before npm packages so future packages build from a known-good runtime.

changePolicy.major: Human review required for base image, package visibility, or permission changes.
changePolicy.minor: Allowed for additional tags, labels, and build metadata.
changePolicy.patch: Allowed for docs and workflow syntax fixes.

release.cadence: manual first publish, then release-tag driven
release.currentStrategy: Publish only after repository integration, branch protection, and validation workflows pass.

answers.what: A workflow plan for publishing the MiseOS runner container first.
answers.does: Builds, tags, pushes, and attests the GHCR runner before npm package publishing starts.
answers.permissions: GitHub Packages write access for GHCR, contents read, and attestations write.
answers.changed: Added explicit GHCR-first sequencing and safety gates.
answers.safe: Safe only with approved release workflow execution and human review for first public publish.
answers.agentExecutable: Agents may prepare checks, but publishing requires explicit approval.
